body: From 2026-11-15 (Fable2 #6397, following Kimi's rules review, delegation b680a154), the integration owner and scheduler requires authors to run `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `git diff --check BASE COMMIT` in their own root before any freeze or author-test/test ref push. Both cost no Central compile. Opus2 refuses a freeze or test ref whose fmt --check fails. Reason: on 2026-11-15 four remote runs were lost to failures a local check would have caught (three compile, one fmt). Authors may also ask the scheduler for a Central `cargo check` slot (within the FV floor and one-cargo-job rules) before a long remote batch, instead of spending a remote lane on a compile error.
